text:
incident-bot: Paging: SEV2 — detected console/API view divergence for paging service. Symptoms: console shows messages delivered but API returns 500 on some routes. Paging oncall @kevin. Incident ID INC-20260315-01.

kevin: I'm on it. any customer reports?

maria: saw two customer tickets, both saying console claims delivered but they get webhook retry loops. linking logs in a sec. /cc @luis

luis: checking dataplane logs now. quick grep shows repeated `config_fetch_timeout` on a few nodes.

kevin: run `rg "config_fetch" /var/log/dataplane/*.log | tail -n 50` and paste outputs.

luis: pasted snippet:
```
[13:02:12] ERROR config_fetch_timeout node=dp-12 req_id=...
[13:02:12] WARN falling back to cached config v=2026-03-15T12:56:00Z
...
```

sara: control plane shows rollout v=2026-03-15T12:56:00Z succeeded. dataplane still reading v=2026-03-15T12:54:00Z on affected nodes.

kevin: hypotheses: 1) flag/rollout didn't propagate to all dataplane nodes. 2) network partition between control plane and subset of dataplane nodes. 3) new config incompatible causing client retries.

maria: how many nodes show mismatch?

luis: 3/24 nodes show stale v=2026-03-15T12:54. they're all in us-west2-rackB.

kevin: quick check: `curl -sS http://dp-12.local:9090/_internal/config | jq -r '.version'` -> `2026-03-15T12:54:00Z`.

sara: control plane API `GET /configs/latest` -> `2026-03-15T12:56:00Z` ✅

deploy-bot: Recent deploy 1769502780 by @maria (config-rollout). No failures reported.

kevin: tcp/connectivity check — any iptables or host blocks?

luis: netstat looks fine. but tcpdump shows retransmits to control-plane IPs around 13:01-13:03.

maria: I'm going to restart `redwood-dataplane` on dp-12 and dp-14 to force re-fetch. coordinating so we don't hit capacity.

kevin: do that and put a short maintenance tag. also enable routing fallback to reduce 500s: `rwctl route set --fallback model=small --priority=low`.

maria: restarted dp-12 & dp-14; dp-12 now reports config v=2026-03-15T12:56:00Z. error logs dropping.

luis: metrics: error-rate for queue xyz in rackB dropped from 18% -> 1.2% after restart + routing change.

kevin: oncall handover at 14:40 to @maria — I need to jump to a customer call. documenting steps & hypotheses here.

maria: taking over. keeping mitigation in place. next: gather full timeline for RCA — tcpdump, journalctl, agent logs from affected nodes -> upload to S3.

kevin: timeline notes for RCA:
1) config rollout started ~13:00
2) control plane reported success ~13:02
3) dataplane nodes in rackB logged `config_fetch_timeout` 13:02-13:04
4) manual restart fixed nodes 13:10-13:15
5) mitigation routing applied 13:08

sara: collecting logs to s3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/INC-20260315-01/ (uploaded)

maria: hypothesis ranking:
- P1: transient network packet loss to control plane for rackB during config push (supported by tcpdump retransmits).
- P2: control plane returned config but TLS handshake anomalies caused clients to reject (low evidence).
- P3: bug in config-fetch retry logic under high connection churn (needs deeper trace).

luis: I'll correlate host-level CPU/memory during rollout and push perf graphs to the bucket.

deploy-bot: No canary failures in other regions.

kevin: customer impact estimate: ~120 failed requests across 2 customers for ~8-12 minutes. CS notified, draft comms ready.

sara: adding action items to RCA: add jitter to config fetch retries, add per-rack config-staleness alert, validate control-plane ack semantics.

maria: flag `use_new_push` was targeted to prod-all in the rollout; rollout mechanism is supposed to be atomic. control-plane shows ack to all nodes, but dp-side ack missing for 3 nodes.

kevin: next actions (short-term):
- run probing script across racks to verify config fetch health
- add retry backoff jitter to config client (PR)
- add alert if >1% nodes in a rack lag behind control-plane config version for >2m

maria: I'll raise the PR for jitter and create the alert rule. assigning @luis for perf graphs and @sara for alerting rule.

luis: uploaded perf graphs and tcpdump excerpts to s3. link in RCA doc.

sara: prepping customer comms now, sending to #customer-facing for approval.

maria: planning to remove active mitigation at 14:50 pending stability window of 15m; will update here.

kevin: leaving detailed notes in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260315-01

maria: last check: no recurrence in last 30m. moving to RCA phase and creating dedicated doc. will ping eng-infra and eng-runtime for follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. tags: data-plane, control-plane, config-propagation.
